item.title: Saudi Summit Postponed To 2027: FII cancels Riyadh meet; Houthi attacks fuel investment uncertainty
item.description: Saudi Arabia's highly anticipated investment conference, initially scheduled for October 26-29, has been postponed due to a rise in missile and drone attacks from Iranian-backed Houthi militants. This pivotal event, often dubbed 'Davos in the Desert', aims to find a new date in 2027. The worsening security situation is making international executives rethink their attendance, which could hinder Saudi Arabia's ambitious economic diversification initiatives moving forward.

Crude holds near $110 per barrel as Middle East tensions keep supply concerns alive
item.description: Currently hovering around $110 a barrel, oil prices are influenced by escalating geopolitical tensions involving Russia and Saudi Arabia. Washington's recent move to relax restrictions on Russian energy exports has shifted market impressions. Attacks claimed by Yemen's Houthis on Saudi facilities have further heightened stability concerns. As a result, prices remain resilient above $100, prompting traders to carefully evaluate the ramifications for global energy security.
item.dc:creator: Shivanghi Payal

item.title: Copenhagen's ByBi grows from a rooftop project to 100 hives, producing six tonnes of honey yearly
item.description: Located in the heart of Copenhagen, ByBi serves as a remarkable social enterprise focused on training marginalized individuals in beekeeping and honey production. With a capacity of 80 to 100 bee colonies, the enterprise yields four to six tonnes of honey annually. Established in 2010, ByBi promotes social inclusion while enhancing urban biodiversity. Its successful model shines as an example for other cities across Europe aspiring to mimic its achievements.

item.title: Texas family sells 650-acre lakefront ranch for $10M+, preserving 86 years of history as a state park
item.description: Texas Parks and Wildlife Foundation has acquired a 650-acre ranch on Lake Palestine for over $10 million. This land will become a new state park, enhancing public access to natural resources. Initially owned by the Pollard family since 1940, the property has significant natural features and wildlife habitats. The state parks department plans to develop guided tours, campsites, and trails after the 2027 purchase completion.

item.title: Couple turn £380,000 Victorian water tower into luxury home, now back on sale for £2.75 million
item.description: A Victorian water tower in Kennington, featured in Grand Designs, is listed for £2.75 million. Previously, it sold for £2.5 million after major renovations from an abandoned structure. The owners invested around £2 million in refurbishments and modern additions over two years. Key features include five bedrooms, four bathrooms, and rooftop terrace views of London landmarks. The landmark property is noteworthy for its combination of historical architecture and contemporary interiors.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: 1848 Massachusetts mill reopens as 86 apartments after $53M restoration, with 69 affordable homes
item.description: Once a 170-year-old stone mill, the Lawrence, Massachusetts landmark has been revitalized with a $53 million restoration, now offering 86 residential units—69 of them affordable housing options. Among these, 58 are tailored for low-income individuals and 11 designed for those in very low-income brackets. Flood prevention measures include ground floor elevation, and the building incorporates energy-efficient features.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Retired couple’s broken heating system replaced with $16k unit for free
item.description: Diane and Brian Johnsen, a retired couple in Beaverton, Oregon, faced financial difficulties in maintaining their home. After their heating and cooling system failed, they sought assistance from the Lennox Feel the Love programme. This initiative provides essential home improvements to qualifying homeowners at no cost. Local contractor Aviator Heating & Cooling installed a new HVAC system valued at $16,000 for the couple.

item.title: Industrial Plan Revived: Developer eyes 1 million sq ft project; residents seek history preserved
item.description: A historic horse racing venue in Texas is poised for transformation into a massive industrial site by Dalfen Industrial, raising concerns regarding the local community's identity and heritage. The developers have proposed a million-square-foot facility but have also committed to donating land for a park and amphitheatre to celebrate the venue's legacy.

item.title: Jennifer Lawrence's $2m gift helped fund a 17-room children's cardiac unit in Kentucky
item.description: In a remarkable philanthropic gesture, Jennifer Lawrence donated $2 million to launch a specialized cardiac intensive care unit at Norton Children's Hospital. This generous act sparked a community wave of fundraising, amassing over $4 million. Opened in early 2020, the unit is specifically equipped to cater to children with critical heart conditions, marking a pivotal enhancement in pediatric cardiac care in her hometown.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Girl, 9, feared wheelchair would spoil Halloween costume; 25 students turned it into a throne
item.description: Nine-year-old Kaelyn Goodman from Florida wanted to dress as a princess angel for Halloween but worried about how her wheelchair would fit into the costume. Twenty-five eighth-grade students at her school stepped in, transforming her wheelchair into an angel throne with wings. The students involved Kaelyn throughout the design process, turning a classroom project into a memorable Halloween experience.

item.title: Emilia Clarke founded SameYou after brain haemorrhages; it has raised £3.8m and helped 1,200+ survivors
item.description: In 2019, Emilia Clarke established SameYou, a charity dedicated to enhancing rehabilitation options for brain injury survivors. With over £3.8 million raised, the initiative has positively impacted more than 1,200 lives. One of its key offerings, NeuroRehabilitation Online, utilizes teletherapy to connect patients with qualified therapists. By focusing on the crucial recovery phase post-hospital, SameYou strives to fill significant gaps in patient care, garnering accolades for its innovative support approaches.

item.title: Brooklyn couple uncover 1901 coal log tied to family history while restoring an 1880s house
item.description: James and Laureta Gale found a 1901 coal delivery schedule during their renovation of a historic lodging house. Their discovery connects to James's family history with coal delivery in Brooklyn. The couple is transforming the 1880s building into an 11-room guesthouse with modern amenities. They are also preserving original features to honor the building's history. The completed guesthouse will display the coal schedule as a tribute to its past.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Over 45% of Saudi flights cancelled since Oct 8, residents scramble for alternatives
item.description: Saudi Arabia is facing major travel disruptions following a large number of flight cancellations since October 8. Due to attacks by Houthi rebels, Riyadh's airport remains closed and travelers seek alternative routes. Businesses and expatriates are navigating challenges associated with remote working and adjusted travel plans. Major events in the country have been postponed or canceled, impacting international investments.
